**Resubmitted: deviation (NONCOMPETE), preferred level, intent defect cured.**

- **Fix applied:** the replacement sentence is now anchored at clause level — "Nothing in **this Section 6** restricts the products the Company may offer, the projects in which the Company may participate, or the Company's use or licensing of the 'Deerskin' brand." This removes the collision with the retained Section 9(b) Globix termination proviso while preserving the full no-restriction result (products, projects, and our own brand).
- **Unchanged:** Section 6.2 (closeout rights), Section 6.3 (HDI-side covenant), Section 9(b), and Section 4.1 all survive verbatim; no extras added.
- **Coverage:** the single preferred element is met in operative language by operation 1; validation returned ok:true with minimality satisfied.
